text: Federated client one records device telemetry before starting a distributed training round.
A reproducible experiment pins the model revision, software environment, and local data partition.
Fully sharded data parallelism divides decoder parameters across the participating accelerators.
The client checks every rank for finite loss before accepting an optimizer step.
Immutable base weights can remain local while selected trainable parameters cross the federation boundary.
A bounded watchdog should distinguish active persistence from a stalled distributed job.
Structured evidence makes cluster failures diagnosable without retaining private training examples.
The training process reports peak allocated and reserved accelerator memory for every rank.
Each federated round begins from the global state produced by the preceding aggregation.
Client updates are averaged only after both expected participants return valid tensor states.
Checkpoint hashes make accidental reuse of a stale global model visible during qualification.
A local dataset checksum prevents silent changes to the qualification corpus between runs.
Rank zero communicates with the federated runtime while all ranks join FSDP collectives.
Frozen parameters are loaded from the same pinned base checkpoint at every participating site.
The trainable state must contain every selected key and must not contain frozen model keys.
Small linear samples provide an independent check that server averaging used both client results.
The next client input should match the exact state persisted after the previous global round.
Production startup kits establish authenticated transport between the server and both clients.
A resource-conscious job fails closed when a client, rank, or expected artifact is absent.
The scheduler allocation is released as soon as evidence collection and cleanup have finished.
Training data stays associated with its client while only selected model state is aggregated.
Deterministic record selection removes random sampler state from a short qualification run.
The optimizer is recreated at the start of each federated round for a controlled FedAvg test.
Multiple local steps produce a loss trajectory instead of a single opaque success marker.
The server persists the aggregated trainable layer after every completed communication round.
Reloading the persisted checkpoint verifies both serialization and the expected tensor schema.
Two independent client partitions should produce different output hashes from a common input.
Equal local step counts give the two clients equal weight in this qualification profile.
Model payload accounting includes tensor count, element size, and the resulting byte total.
Offline model loading prevents an allocated GPU job from waiting on an external download.
The server model contains only the trainable decoder layer needed for aggregation and persistence.
The local full model still participates in forward and backward computation on every client.
A selected parameter must change by a finite positive amount in every training round.
The control plane is qualified separately before the expensive accelerator allocation is requested.
Client readiness is proven by structured events from both four-rank worker groups.
No Python object broadcast carries the full model state between distributed training ranks.
Distributed checkpoint APIs scatter rank-zero tensors directly into local parameter shards.
The evidence validator rejects incomplete rounds, duplicate records, and mismatched model paths.
GPU monitoring samples all eight allocated device indices throughout the production job.
A completion grace period is granted only after aggregation or persistence progress is verified.
The final report separates useful training time from startup, transfer, and persistence overhead.
Trainable-only exchange makes repeated federated rounds practical for a fourteen billion parameter base.
The experiment records the exact Git commit and refuses a dirty checkout before submission.
Site-specific examples exercise federated heterogeneity without claiming benchmark model quality.
A formal pass requires completed scheduler status and all fail-closed evidence invariants.
The persisted state checksum becomes the expected client input checksum for the following round.
Aggregation samples are compared with the equal-weight mean of corresponding client samples.
The qualification ends only after three rounds, final reload, and artifact capture all pass.
